newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bonds end mixed to higher, trade slow.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bonds end mixed to higher, trade slow.

text.p: 1650 GMT - Dutch bonds close at their midday levels with trade inspired only by 600 million guilder Dec 2006 6.125 percent Batavia Credit Card which started trading in the afternoon, causing switching from February 2007 state loans.
* Sept 2001 116.53/63, bid yld 4.75 pct vs 116.54/64, 4.76. * Jan 2006 rises 18 basis points to 101.49/59 from 101.31/41, bid yield 5.78 pct versus 5.81.
* 10-yr yield spread vs April 2006 bund steady at -8 basis pts.
* Jan 2023s 111.48/68, 6.57 pct yield, up 25 basis points.
